brand.name: Driftwrite
brand.tagline: Write without the noise. Focus on what matters.

sections.purpose: App shell with sidebar and top bar
sections.copy: Sidebar: 'Documents' with a count of 3. Top bar: 'Driftwrite' logo, active item 'Document List', and user menu (profile icon).

sections.purpose: Primary work area with editor screen
sections.copy: Editor canvas with a large, clean text area. Toolbar includes 'Bold', 'Italic', 'Heading', and 'Undo' buttons.

sections.purpose: Item components with hover and active states
sections.copy: Document cards with title, last edited date, and tags. Hover: subtle border highlight. Active: background tint and expanded details.
Right rail shows document metadata: 'Last Edited: 10 minutes ago', 'Word Count: 245', and 'Tags: [Work, Draft]'.
Empty-state hint: 'You have no documents. Start writing now.' with a '+ New Document' button.

type_hint: Modern system sans-serif, light-to-regular weights, tight headings, big size jumps
